standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that the module of maps from a ring into an injective module is injective
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the end of the counted proof (source lines 610-611)
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the middle term of the displayed sequence injective.

core_obligations: Exhibit a short exact sequence: construct maps from the extended module into the module of maps from the polynomial ring into itself and back so that the sequence of modules over the polynomial ring is exact (proof lines 598-604)
Check surjectivity: the second map becomes the shift map on the product decomposition and is surjective (proof lines 605-607)

Injectivity of the terms: the extended module is a direct sum of copies of the injective module, hence injective over the base ring, and the middle term is a module of maps into an injective module, hence injective; the two-term resolution gives injective amplitude in degrees zero and one (proof lines 608-612)
proof_roadmap: 记 E[x] = E ⊗_A A[x]；写出 A[x]-模的短正合列 0 → E[x] → Hom_A(A[x], E[x]) → Hom_A(A[x], E[x]) → 0，其中第一映射 p ↦ (f ↦ fp)、第二映射 φ ↦ (f ↦ φ(xf) − xφ(f))。
第二映射满：Hom_A(A[x], E[x]) = ∏_{n≥0} E[x]，它在 (e_n) 上为 (e_{n+1} − x e_n)，显然满。
E[x] ≅ ⊕_{n≥0} E 作为 A-模 ⇒ 内射（直和引理）；Hom_A(A[x], E[x]) 内射（映射入内射引理）⇒ 该两项分解给出内射幅度 [0,1]。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that extending scalars of an injective module along a polynomial ring in one variable gives an object of injective amplitude concentrated in degrees zero and one (author lemma at source lines 590-596, label lemma-injective-dimension-over-polynomial-ring). The proof (source lines 598-613) exhibits an explicit two-term resolution by injective modules over the polynomial ring, checking exactness and surjectivity of the second map by a product decomposition and injectivity of the two terms by the direct-sum and mapping-into-injective statements (proof lines 598-612). The explicit resolution is the substance. H3.
